record.question: It is dangerous to enter __________ the enemy's camp.
record.explanation: Answer D: into. Enter into means go inside/enter a place (D). Independent check: “Enter into” emphasizes movement from outside to the inside of the camp; option D is the natural completion. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/into-or-in. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
